name: Zozo Portfolio for Elementor
author: zozothemes

sections.description:
Zozo Portfolio for Elementor is a feature-rich Elementor portfolio plugin that helps you create stunning portfolio grids, galleries, sliders, and videos with advanced filters, hover effects, and AJAX loading with RTL Support.

Built for designers, agencies, photographers, developers, and creatives who want maximum layout flexibility without performance compromise.

Live Demo
Documentation

Portfolio Layouts

Create visually engaging portfolio layouts using Elementor with full control over columns, spacing, and responsiveness.

  • Portfolio Grid
    Display your projects in a clean and structured grid layout with flexible column control and fullwidth support. Ideal for showcasing work with consistent spacing, responsive behavior, and smooth hover interactions across all devices.
    Demos:
    Portfolio 2 column
    Portfolio 3 column
    Portfolio 4 column
    Portfolio Grid Fullwidth

  • Portfolio List & List Slider
    Present portfolio items in 2/3/4 Column and slider format. Perfect for storytelling layouts, case studies, or detailed project presentations with image, title, and content alignment.
    Demos:
    Portfolio List
    Portfolio List Slider

  • Portfolio Masonry
    Create visually dynamic masonry layouts that adapt naturally to Columns fit. Supports AJAX filtering, gutter and no-gutter styles, and multiple column options, making it ideal for creative and gallery-style portfolios.
    Demos:
    Portfolio Masonry 2 Column
    Portfolio Masonry 3 Column
    Portfolio Masonry 4 Column
    Portfolio Masonry with No Gutter
    Portfolio Masonry with No Gutter

Advanced Sliders & Effects

Bring motion and interaction to your portfolio presentations.

  • Portfolio Slider
    Showcase portfolio items in a smooth, touch-friendly slider with full Elementor control. Ideal for highlighting featured projects, case studies, or homepage showcases with responsive navigation and performance-optimized transitions.
    Demo:
    Portfolio Slider

  • Slider Center Mode
    Emphasize your active portfolio item by placing it in the center while surrounding slides appear partially visible. This layout is perfect for modern, interactive presentations and draws attention to key projects without overwhelming the viewer.
    Demo:
    Portfolio Slider Center

  • CoverFlow, Cube, Fade, Flip Effects
    Add cinematic motion to your portfolio sliders using advanced transition effects. Choose from CoverFlow, Cube, Fade, or Flip animations to create immersive visual experiences that feel premium and engaging across all devices.
    Demos:
    Portfolio Carousel CoverFlow
    Portfolio Carousel Cube
    Portfolio Carousel Fade
    Portfolio Carousel Flip

  • Portfolio Pagination & AJAX Load More
    Control how users browse your portfolio with classic pagination, AJAX load more, or infinite scrolling. Content loads dynamically without page refresh, improving user experience and keeping visitors engaged longer.
    Demos:
    Portfolio with Pagination
    Portfolio with AJAX Load More
    Portfolio with Infinite Scroll

  • Gallery Variations
    Create visually rich image galleries with flexible layout options designed for speed and responsiveness. Each gallery adapts seamlessly to different screen sizes while maintaining sharp visuals and smooth interactions.
    Demos:
    Default Gallery
    Grid Gallery
    Masonry Gallery
    360° Image Viewer

  • Video Portfolio Layouts
    Designed for video-first portfolios, these layouts help you present motion content in a clean, engaging, and professional way. Ideal for filmmakers, agencies, content creators, and marketing teams.
    Demos:
    Fullwidth Video
    Tilt Video
    Video Slider
    Video Slider Center
    Video Flip
    Video Cube
    Video Coverflow
    Video List Video

  • Hover & Interaction Styles
    Enhance user engagement with modern hover effects that reveal project details without cluttering the layout. Designed to feel smooth, lightweight, and visually appealing.
    Demos:
    Mouse Hover
    Mouse Hover Light
    Overlay Effects
    Portfolio Tilt

  • RTL Support
    Zozo Portfolio is fully optimized for Right-to-Left languages, ensuring consistent layout behavior, navigation flow, and visual alignment for global audiences.
    Demos:
    Portfolio Grid RTL
    Portfolio List RTL
    Masonry Filter RTL
    Portfolio Slider RTL
    Pagination RTL

Key Features at a Glance

✔ Custom Post Type for Portfolios
✔ Portfolio Categories & Tags
✔ Elementor Widgets (Grid, Masonry, Slider, List, Filter, Accordion)
✔ AJAX Filtering, Load More & Infinite Scroll
✔ Lightbox Integration
✔ Responsive & Mobile-Optimized
✔ Theme Independent
✔ RTL Ready

Who Is This Plugin For?

  • Designers showcasing work
  • Agencies presenting case studies
  • Photographers & videographers
  • Developers building client portfolios
  • Elementor users who want flexibility without bloated addons

More Details: https://zozothemes.com/
Support: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/zozo-portfolio/

Support

sections.installation:
1. Upload the zozo-portfolio folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated
  4. Start creating portfolios using the new “Portfolio” menu item in your WordPress dashboard
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes, Elementor is required because all portfolio widgets depend on Elementor’s page builder interface.

Can I customize portfolio templates?

Yes. You can override templates by placing custom files inside:
your-theme/zozo-portfolio/

Does it work with any theme?

Yes, the plugin is fully theme-independent and works with any modern WordPress theme.

Is AJAX filtering supported?

Yes, the plugin includes AJAX filtering, load more, and infinite scroll.

Are external libraries included?

Yes, libraries such as Swiper, Isotope, Pannellum, and Magnific Popup are included under their respective licenses.
